name: Dead Field
summary: In northern Silverpine Forest, Forsaken assaults falter at Dead Field, a ruined farmstead. Rot Hide gnolls serve the Scourge there, and the banshee Nightlash drives back each attack.

sections.title: A Blighted Staging Ground
sections.body:
In northern Silverpine Forest, the ruined farmstead has stood empty since its human occupants were lost in the Third War. Rot Hide gnolls now use the plot as a base and willingly serve the Scourge. Deathstalker scouts have seen signs of a coming military buildup that threatens Forsaken supply lines and outposts.

Small Forsaken assaults on the farm have failed again and again. Whenever the gnolls are in danger, Nightlash, a wailing banshee, appears and drives the attackers back.

sections.title: Ravenclaw's Ambition
sections.body: Thule Ravenclaw directs the Rot Hide gnolls from Fenris Isle. The necromancer seeks Scourge rule over Silverpine and wants to drive Sylvanas's forces from Lordaeron. He sends magical apparitions to the farmstead to survey his undead horde and warn Forsaken intruders.

faq.answer: Dead Field is a ruined farmstead in northern Silverpine Forest. Once an ordinary human farm, it fell into ruin and now holds Rot Hide gnolls aligned with the Scourge.

faq.q: Why are there gnolls at the farm?
faq.answer: The Rot Hide gnolls serve the Scourge and use the farmstead to gather forces and prepare attacks on Forsaken positions in northern Silverpine Forest.
Nightlash is a Scourge banshee who commands the Rot Hide gnolls at the farm. When Forsaken forces attack, she appears to defend her servants and drive back their attempts to reclaim the land.

faq.q: Who commands the Scourge forces here?
faq.answer: Thule Ravenclaw commands the Scourge forces here from nearby Fenris Isle. The powerful necromancer directs the gnolls through apparitions and magical oversight to harass Forsaken expansion.

angles.text: For you, the Forsaken, the Scourge foothold at Dead Field threatens the road between the Sepulcher and northern Lordaeron. It must be wiped out swiftly.
As a rogue, you know Deathstalker scouts watch the farm closely. Infiltrating the gnoll ranks and striking their command is a critical military aim.
